channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 47 new entries
item.description:
47 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, proteomics, histology / imaging-only, metabolomics, and 3 more.

highSpaClone
Infers copy number alterations and tumor subclones from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics using spatial constraints.

spAlignDE
Aligns spatial omics datasets across samples and modalities via diffeomorphic registration and estimates mismatch-aware differential expression.

sosta
Bioconductor package for structure-based analysis of multicellular anatomical structures in spatial omics data.

MuSpAn
Modality-agnostic toolbox offering spatial statistics, topological data analysis, geometry and network tools for multiscale tissue analysis.

CellART
Extracts single-cell information from high-resolution spatial transcriptomics via combined deep learning and probabilistic modeling.

EISCA/EISTA
End-to-end nf-core pipelines standardizing single-cell RNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics analysis workflows.

CoexpressDeconvolve
Reference-free framework recovering integer cell counts and cell-type transcriptomes via topic modeling on spatial co-expression data.

PlantCCC
Graph-attention framework prioritizing context-specific ligand-receptor communication in plant spatial transcriptomics.

SpaCoEx
Sparse framework selecting genes based on spatially varying co-expression structure in spatial transcriptomics.

PhenoMapR
Semi-supervised method mapping bulk expression phenotype signatures onto single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data.

LMDmapper
Desktop application mapping laser-microdissection pixel coordinates to stage coordinates for spatial sample tracking.

SIMPlex
Generates matched spatial and single-nucleus transcriptomic profiles from a single FFPE tissue section.

SPRINT
Reconstructs spatial proteomic (and metabolite) profiles by fusing spatial gene expression with H&E histology images.

FOCST
Predicts spatial transcriptomic profiles from histology images using foundation-model-driven contrastive learning and a GNN.

DPAS-Graph
Graph-based relation-learning framework predicting spatial protein abundance from spatial transcriptomic data.

Independent benchmark of H&E-based gene expression prediction in skin
Independently benchmarks three published H&E-to-expression prediction models against simple baselines in skin.

spaCraft
Estimates statistical power and per-group sample size for multi-sample spatial transcriptomics studies from pilot data.

RIPIN
An RNase-inhibiting tissue preservation protocol that improves RNA integrity for MERFISH spatial transcriptomics.

Multi-Center Study on Sample Preparation and Feature Selection Effects in Reproducible Mass Spectrometry Imaging for Clinical Translation
Multi-center evaluation of sample-prep and feature-selection workflows for reproducible MALDI-MSI proteomic imaging.

Velociraptor
Machine learning workflow using marker enrichment modeling to register and match cell phenotypes across cytometry platforms.

ggsc
R package for visualizing single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

SpotSweeper
Spatially-aware quality control method to detect local outliers and artifacts in spatial transcriptomics data.

SemanticST
Graph neural network with mini-batch training and multi-semantic fusion for spatial niche detection and sample integration.

Cold solvent washing AFADESI-MSI
Cold solvent washing step enhances lipid detection sensitivity in AFADESI mass spectrometry imaging of tissue.

COAST
Aligns consecutive multi-omics tissue sections using only associated images, without shared molecular features.

MP-MSI (AFADESI)
High-throughput microplate mass spectrometry imaging workflow combining targeted quantitation and untargeted metabolomics.

6-AQ/DHB matrix
Binary MALDI matrix enabling isomer-selective, high-sensitivity imaging of mono- and oligosaccharides in tissue.

mspix
Efficient file format and Python tools for storing and accessing high-pixel-count mass spectrometry images.

SPOT (Spatial Omics Toolkit)
Open-source pipeline applying single-cell/spatial-transcriptomics statistical methods to mass spectrometry imaging data.

SCIGMA
Deep learning framework with uncertainty-aware contrastive learning and graph networks for integrating spatial multiomics data.

Spl-ISO-Seq2
Spatial long-read isoform sequencing at 500-nm/single-cell resolution with Spl-IsoQuant-2/Spl-IsoFind software.

Spatial-ATAC-Hi-C
Microfluidic platform for spatially resolved joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and 3D genome organization in tissue.

spatial NT-seq
Combines transgenesis-free metabolic RNA labeling with in situ chemical recoding to co-map new and pre-existing RNA spatially.

hex-MASP
3D-printed hexagonal micro-well platform for whole-tissue spatial proteomic mapping via LC-MS.

jsPCA
Computes spatial covariance via joint PCA to identify spatial domains and variable genes across multi-slice/sample datasets.

UniGeneX
Generative foundation model reconstructs a universal gene expression space integrating single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

LRSPAT
Low-rank framework approximating spatial statistics (Moran's I, Geary's C) for fast spatially variable gene detection.

spatialMET
Open-source end-to-end framework for preprocessing, spatial domain detection and analysis of MSI data.

MechanoMaST
Computationally co-registers AFM nanoindentation stiffness maps with spatial transcriptomics from adjacent tissue sections.

Paired-surface spatial mechanomics
Co-registers tissue stiffness maps from nanoindentation with adjacent Visium HD spatial transcriptomics.

Kintsugi
Deterministic tessellation partitions subcellular ST count matrices by UMI density to reveal nucleus-poor tissue compartments.

Ageas
Time-agnostic transfer learning framework inferring cell fate bias from single-cell and spatial multi-omics snapshots.

AltraFlowSOM
Semi-supervised FlowSOM extension embedding expert annotations for IMC cell phenotyping and rare population detection.

FACTMx
Variational encoder-decoder framework jointly modeling structured multimodal patient data for interpretable latent representations.

Poly Pipeline
Universal workflow converting formats and clustering/co-expression analysis for spatial transcriptomics in polyploid and diploid organisms.

SCR (Spatial Covariance Regression)
Bayesian factor-model framework estimating spatially-resolved gene co-expression networks to identify spatially co-expressed genes.

spoQC
Modular framework for multimodal quality control of imaging-based spatially resolved transcriptomics data.
